unresolvedConflicts.subject: Hotwire Communications cross-manager attribution

The separate Blackstone census retained Hotwire pending confirmation, creating a potential cross-manager double count.
unresolvedConflicts.recommendedResolution: Treat Hotwire Communications as an active Brookfield holding and review the Blackstone row for exit or retirement so the company is not counted under both managers.
